description.value: HiFive Chicken is a BC-born fast food chain founded in Vancouver in 2016 that has expanded to over 11 locations across the province. The Langley location sits in Willoughby Town Centre and serves roasted and fried chicken in multiple formats, from personal meals to family party packs. Touring cyclists will find a full menu of hot food including sandwiches, sides, and desserts, with both in-store and online ordering available.

address.value: 20727 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley, BC V2Y1X1
